desc:
🌱 A cozy open-world adventure — in development!

Pull weeds, take jobs, earn coins & rank up your weeding license! Explore the meadow, forest, lake & walled town to meet creatures—some friendly, some not.

✨ What you can do now
- Weeding, hunting & parcel delivery jobs
- Furnish & decorate your own house
- Fishing & rowboats at the lake
- Shops, ramen, rides & outfits
- Ride bikes/cars with friends or feed & ride a giant bird
- Wake up the big sleepy forest creature if you dare
- Day, night & rain cycles

🚧 Demo Stage
A fun hobby project made during my university life :) Expect bugs & big changes!

💛 Free-to-Play fan game made for fun! All assets made by us. Credit: Nagano
